strings.empty_home: Add an expense, income, task or note to get started.
strings.empty_tasks: No tasks yet. Add one with just a title.
strings.empty_notes: No notes yet. Write down what matters.
strings.empty_money: No recorded income or expenses yet.
strings.no_account_hint: These records are not linked to an account and do not change any account balance. Each currency is shown separately.
strings.local_privacy: Registration is not required. Records stay on this device; cloud synchronization is not connected.
strings.invalid_amount: Enter a positive amount within the supported range.
strings.amount_precision: Use the number of decimal places supported by this currency.
strings.operation_conflict: This operation identifier was already used with other data. Close the form and check your records before adding again.
strings.change_failed: Could not confirm the change. Check device storage before trying again.
strings.save_failed: Could not confirm saving. Your input is still here. Check the device storage and try again.
strings.read_failed: The record was saved, but the list could not be refreshed. Reopen the app; do not add it again.
strings.storage_key_missing: The key to the existing database is missing. Data has not been replaced. Restore the matching backup or contact support.
strings.storage_unavailable: Could not open local storage. Data has not been replaced. Check device storage and try again.
strings.welcome_body: Start with one record. Keep your income, expenses, tasks and notes together — without registration or extra setup.
strings.revision_conflict: This record has changed. Reopen it before saving.
strings.undo_unavailable: This change can no longer be undone.
strings.delete_confirm: Delete this record? You can undo this action.
strings.delete_series: Delete this event and all repeats?
strings.reminder_message: A planned record needs your attention.
strings.scheduling_pending: Schedule saved. Native scheduling has not been confirmed; reopen the app and check permissions.
strings.alarm_limits: Android may delay delivery or silence alerts because of permissions, Do Not Disturb, volume, battery limits, or force stop. Alarms sound for up to 10 minutes. Test delivery on your phone.
strings.native_unavailable: Native feature unavailable in this environment
strings.test_message: This is a LifeOS test notification. Check its sound and visibility.
strings.backup_privacy: Records stay in an encrypted database on this device. Backups use your password and are saved to a file you choose. The password cannot be recovered. No cloud synchronization.
strings.backup_password_help: At least 12 characters. Keep it separately: recovery is impossible without it.
strings.restore_password_help: Enter the password for this backup.
strings.backup_invalid: Backup is corrupt, incompatible, or the password is incorrect
strings.restore_warning: Current data will be replaced by the backup. First save a separate copy of your current data. Restore is atomic and runs after validation.
strings.appearance_preview: Live preview. Changes are saved only when you tap Apply.
strings.wallpaper_fallback: Falls back to your chosen palette when unavailable.
strings.wallpaper_available: Accent taken from the device wallpaper.
strings.backup_steps: Password → encrypted file → verification → restore confirmation
strings.backup_step_password: Step 1. Enter a password. The app does not store it.
strings.backup_step_encrypt: Step 2. Encrypting records on this device.
strings.backup_step_file: Choose a file in the system picker.
strings.backup_step_confirm: Review the backup before replacing current data.
strings.backup_cancelled: Cancelled. Existing data has been preserved.
strings.reminder_no_future: There is no future reminder. Choose another time or adjust the repeat rule.
strings.offline_empty: No records yet. Add the first when you need it.
strings.name: Name
strings.not_actual: Plan — not an actual transaction yet
strings.transfer_help: Transfers are neither income nor expenses. For different currencies, enter both amounts explicitly.
strings.currency_mismatch: Account and transaction currencies differ, or same-currency transfer amounts differ.
strings.split_total: Split amounts must equal the purchase total. Adjust or remove splits before changing the amount.
strings.archive_instead: Archive this item to preserve its history.
strings.split_help: All splits make one purchase. Spending is counted only once.
strings.manual_estimate: Manual estimate, no quotes or trading
strings.wealth_link_help: These records do not move real money. Explicitly link to an already recorded transaction when needed.
strings.cash_link_mismatch: Linked transaction has a different currency, direction or amount. Correct or remove the link first.
strings.position_short: Selling more units than available on this date.
strings.import_private: The file is processed on device and never retained by LifeOS. CSV, TSV, TXT, JSON, OFX, QIF and XLSX. Export XLS or PDF as CSV. Formulas are rejected.
strings.import_format: Unsupported format or encoding. Export UTF-8 CSV without formulas.
strings.import_columns: Selected column is missing in this row
strings.import_duplicate: Possible duplicate — select only if this is a new record
strings.import_already_selected: These rows were already imported. Select only new rows.
strings.import_edited: Batch records have been edited. Automatic reversal stopped to protect your data.
strings.habit_repeat_required: Choose a repeat rule for this habit
strings.single_schedule: A linked task uses its own schedule
strings.task_cycle: A subtask cannot be its own ancestor
strings.wellness_nonmedical: Personal time log, without medical data.
strings.has_active_children: Finish or remove linked records first. Data will not be hidden automatically.
strings.profiles_local_only: Profiles exist only here. Invitations, family access and sync are not available. Private records remain private.
strings.membership_metadata: This prepares future permission data. These settings do not give access to other people or devices.
strings.owner_immutable: Owner identity and role remain immutable
strings.clear_habit_check: Clear completion instead of deleting history
strings.module_calendar_owned: Edit the schedule in its module
strings.reverse_import_help: Only unchanged records from this import will be removed. Reversal stops if a record has been edited or linked to an obligation.
strings.amount_direction: How to interpret income and expenses
strings.sign_rules: Negative means expense, positive means income
strings.import_json_decimal: JSON decimal amounts must be strings, for example "12.50", to prevent rounding.
strings.import_number_ambiguous: Ambiguous number separators. Check the selected decimal format.
strings.ux_hint_projects: Move toward a goal with milestones, tasks and deadlines.

strings.ux_hint_subjects: Subjects, assignments and upcoming deadlines together.
strings.ux_hint_checklists: Shopping and chores: add items and check them off.
strings.ux_hint_wellness: Log activity or sleep and review your recent entries.

strings.ux3_account_body: Plans, money and family care in one place. Your private records stay private.

1. Create your family space.
2. Invite an equal co-parent.
3. Add children and choose their access.
